name: llm-box
description: Terminal-first workflow automation engine. Generate and execute YAML workflows from plain English descriptions. 20+ built-in nodes including fetch_url, execute, file I/O, HTTP requests, JSON parsing, template rendering, and 15+ LLM providers (Ollama, DeepSeek, OpenAI-compatible).

interface.shortDescription: Terminal-first workflow engine: plain English to YAML to execution
interface.longDescription: llm-box is a terminal-first workflow automation tool. Describe what you want in plain English, and it generates executable YAML workflows. Features 20+ built-in nodes (fetch_url, execute, file I/O, HTTP, JSON parsing, template rendering), 15+ LLM providers (Ollama, DeepSeek, OpenAI-compatible), and an MCP server mode for integration with Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use llm-box to create a workflow
Use llm-box to run a workflow
